clockConvention.sourceFrame: one-based sprite frame; visual ticks are source 12-fps ticks
clockConvention.blocksThroughFrame: count includes a stream block on the named frame
clockConvention.declaredSampleStart: sum of preceding blocks in this sprite, starting at zero
clockConvention.declaredSampleEnd: sum through this frame's block, or unchanged when no block
clockConvention.signedBlockSeekSamples: source SWF signed seek field; no browser offset correction inferred
clockConvention.browserPcmEncoding: interleaved float32 little endian by frame then channel
